## Featured case studies

- [Morocco Immersion](https://eddahby.tech/projects/morocco-immersion-platform): Travel platform and operations dashboard using Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Auth.js.
- [SoloTradeKit](https://eddahby.tech/projects/solo-trade-kit): Field-service SaaS for solo tradespeople covering customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, payments, and reminders.
- [Prompt Bunker](https://eddahby.tech/projects/prompt-bunker): Collaborative prompt operations SaaS with versioning, AI review, tasks, team roles, and billing.
- [Event Dev Hub](https://eddahby.tech/projects/event-dev-hub): Developer-event discovery and booking experience built with Next.js and MongoDB.
- [SaaS AI Starter](https://eddahby.tech/projects/saas-ai-starter): A docs-first delivery system for multi-tenant AI products.
- [Mosque Administration System](https://eddahby.tech/projects/mosque-administration-system): Role-aware community operations platform built with ASP.NET Core MVC.
